blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — All 19 Filipino crew members of a Liberian-flagged vessel that came under an apparent drone attack in the Black Sea were safely rescued by the Bulgarian military, although two of them suffered minor injuries, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) reported on Thursday.
